results.name: Real API success and JSON parsing
results.detail: Unintercepted HTTP 200; 250 records parsed and rendered in Chrome; CORS allowed.

results.name: Four ES modules
results.detail: main.js, api.js, ui.js and utils.js loaded with no import errors.

results.name: Country fields and flags
results.detail: Name, capital, region, formatted population, language and labeled undistorted flag verified against live Japan record.

results.name: Search and empty state
results.detail: Exact, partial, case-insensitive, padded and blank queries; no-results query zzzz-no-country; clearing restores results.

results.name: Regions, combined search and reset
results.detail: All five primary regions and Antarctic checked; matching/excluded combinations and reset tested. One API request total; no keystroke fetches or page navigation.

results.name: Responsive 320px
results.detail: 1 card columns; document/body fit viewport; controls at least 44px high; flags use contain.

results.name: Responsive 390px
results.detail: 1 card columns; document/body fit viewport; controls at least 44px high; flags use contain.

results.name: Responsive 768px
results.detail: 2 card columns; document/body fit viewport; controls at least 44px high; flags use contain.

results.name: Responsive 1366px
results.detail: 3 card columns; document/body fit viewport; controls at least 44px high; flags use contain.

results.name: Keyboard and accessibility
results.detail: Search/select labels, focus outline, Tab order, keyboard region selection, Enter reset, focus return, and nonnavigating form submission tested; live status and flag alt checked.

results.name: Normal console and asset QA
results.detail: Zero console errors, uncaught errors, failed requests, HTTP errors, CORS errors or import failures throughout real success/search/filter/viewport flow.

results.name: Loading lifecycle
results.detail: Held request shows busy/loading and disabled controls at four widths; completing it renders results and enables controls.

results.name: HTTP response.ok handling and real Retry
results.detail: 503 JSON body goes to visible error instead of success; keyboard Retry makes a second real network request, restores 250 results/focus without reloading.

results.name: Network failure
results.detail: Browser-level request abort caught; connection guidance and Retry visible with no uncaught rejection.

results.name: Malformed JSON
results.detail: Invalid JSON handled as user-facing error; busy state cleared.

results.name: Unexpected payloads
results.detail: Object payload, null record, missing required fields and duplicate country codes all rejected safely.

results.name: Empty API payload
results.detail: Empty array is a valid empty state, not a parser crash or permanent loading state.

results.name: Safe rendering and missing optional data
results.detail: HTML-like country name stays literal; missing capital/population/languages use Not listed.

results.name: Request timeout
results.detail: 15-second timeout accelerated only in QA; request abort produces visible timeout guidance and clears loading.

results.name: Flag failure fallback
results.detail: Failed image replaced with explicit fallback text; country facts stay available.

results.name: Broken lab reproduced
results.detail: Real request reproduces exact TypeError; inspection confirms Promise instead of array and busy/loading remains stuck.

results.name: Fixed lab real success
results.detail: Corrected lab awaits JSON, renders three real country names, shows array inspection and clears busy with no new console errors.
